chapters.label: Live: the 2012 quarter-final
chapters.text: Bangkok, 2012, a Futsal World Cup quarter-final. Argentina against Brazil, two all, four minutes left. Leandro Cuzzolino shoots from far out. Tiago leaps. What a save!

chapters.label: Replay: ride with the ball
chapters.text: Ride with the ball. It gets there in a blink, so Tiago has to react fast. Brazil won three to two after extra time, and became world champions!

chapters.label: How he does it (demo)
chapters.text: How he does it: weight forward, up on your toes, knees soft. Flat on your heels, you are too late. Keep your weight forward, on your toes, ready to spring!
